patterns: How can I register as a medical practitioner?
How can I register as a dental practitioner?
How do I become a licensed doctor in Kenya?
responses: To register as a medical or dental practitioner in Kenya, visit https://portal.kmpdc.go.ke and complete the online application form.

patterns: What documents are required for practitioner registration?
Which documents do I need for registration?
responses: You will need your national ID or passport, academic certificates, internship completion certificate, and proof of payment.

patterns: How long does it take to get a practicing license?
When will my license be ready?
responses: Processing usually takes 2–4 weeks after submitting all required documents and fees.

patterns: How can I renew my medical license?
responses: You can renew your license online via the KMPDC portal at https://portal.kmpdc.go.ke using your practitioner account.

patterns: What are the fees for registration?
How much is the practitioner registration fee?
responses: Fees vary depending on practitioner category. Please refer to the official fee schedule on https://kmpdc.go.ke.

patterns: How can I check if my license is valid?
responses: You can check your license validity at https://kmpdc.go.ke under the 'Registers' section.

patterns: How do I apply for temporary registration?
responses: Foreign-trained doctors can apply for temporary registration via the KMPDC online portal with valid work permits and credentials.

patterns: How can I register a health facility?
responses: To register or renew a health facility license, apply online through https://portal.kmpdc.go.ke and upload the required documents.

patterns: What are the requirements for opening a new clinic?
responses: You will need proof of premises ownership, facility layout plan, staff details, and compliance with KMPDC facility standards.

patterns: How can I verify a hospital?
Check if a hospital is approved by KMPDC
responses: You can verify licensed hospitals and clinics at https://kmpdc.go.ke under 'Health Facilities'.

patterns: What happens if a facility operates without a license?
responses: Operating without a valid license is illegal and may lead to closure and legal action by KMPDC.
KMPDC conducts regular and random inspections to ensure compliance with healthcare standards.
You can find a list of accredited medical and dental schools on the KMPDC website under 'Students' or 'Approved Institutions'.

patterns: How can I apply for internship placement?
responses: Apply for internship placement via the KMPDC online portal and ensure your documents are verified by your training institution.

patterns: What are the requirements for foreign-trained doctors?
responses: Foreign-trained practitioners must submit certified academic documents, proof of internship, and valid work authorization.

patterns: How does KMPDC assess foreign qualifications?
responses: KMPDC evaluates foreign qualifications based on curriculum equivalence and verification from the awarding institution.

patterns: How can I report a complaint?
File a complaint against a doctor
responses: You can report complaints through https://kmpdc.go.ke/complaints or email complaints@kmpdc.go.ke.

patterns: What is the process for investigating medical malpractice?
responses: KMPDC investigates complaints through a formal inquiry process, which may involve hearings and expert review.

patterns: Can I remain anonymous when filing a complaint?
responses: You may submit a complaint anonymously, but providing contact details helps KMPDC follow up effectively.

patterns: How long does it take for a complaint to be resolved?
When will I get feedback on my complaint?
responses: Resolution time depends on case complexity but usually takes a few weeks to months after investigation begins.

patterns: How do I access the KMPDC online portal?
responses: Access the KMPDC online portal at https://portal.kmpdc.go.ke using your email and password.

patterns: How can I make payments online?
responses: Log into your portal account at https://portal.kmpdc.go.ke and follow payment instructions using M-Pesa or bank transfer.

patterns: Can I download my license certificate?
responses: Yes, once approved, you can download your license certificate directly from your KMPDC portal account.
KMPDC is located on Woodlands Road, Hurlingham, Nairobi. Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM.

patterns: How can I contact customer care?
responses: You can reach KMPDC via email info@kmpdc.go.ke or call +254-20-2726300.
KMPDC operates nationally with the main office in Nairobi. County-level operations are coordinated through regional inspections.

patterns: How can I confirm if a doctor is registered?
responses: You can confirm a doctor’s registration on https://kmpdc.go.ke under 'Registers' > 'Practitioners'.

patterns: How can I find licensed health facilities near me?
Find registered clinics in my area
responses: Search for licensed health facilities by county or town at https://kmpdc.go.ke under 'Health Facilities'.
